# CloudFormation deploy

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Create, review, and execute a CloudFormation change set (or delete the stack)

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/cloudformation-deploy@v1
  with:
    stack-name: # CloudFormation stack name.
```

## How it works

Deploy a CloudFormation stack through a change set, so the diff is reviewable before it
runs.

`aws cloudformation deploy` is one command that plans and applies in the same breath —
convenient, and the reason CloudFormation changes so often land unreviewed. This action
splits it the way `terraform plan` / `terraform apply` are split:

  mode: change-set  → create the change set, render the resource diff, DON'T execute
  mode: execute     → execute a change set that already exists (by name)
  mode: deploy      → create and execute in one run (trunk-based, or a dispatch)
  mode: delete      → tear the stack down

The interesting details, all of which are things CloudFormation gets wrong by default:

  • **"No changes" is not a failure.** `create-change-set` completes with status FAILED
    when the template is identical to the deployed stack. That is a successful no-op, and
    treating it as an error means every re-run of an unchanged stack goes red. Detected
    and reported as `has-changes: false`.
  • **`REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS` stacks are not real stacks.** A stack left in that state by a
    failed first change set cannot be updated — only created. The change-set type is
    chosen accordingly instead of blindly using UPDATE.
  • **Replacement is the dangerous verb.** The rendered diff flags every resource
    CloudFormation intends to *replace*, because replacing an RDS instance and updating
    one look identical in a raw change set.

Authenticate with `aws-auth` first.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stack-name` | **yes** | — | CloudFormation stack name. |
| `template` | no | `""` | Path to the template file, or an `https://s3...` URL. Required unless `mode` is `execute` or `delete`. |
| `mode` | no | `change-set` | change-set \| execute \| deploy \| delete |
| `parameters` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `Key=Value` stack parameters. A value of `__USE_PREVIOUS__` keeps the currently deployed value, which is how you avoid re-supplying secrets on update. |
| `parameters-file` | no | `""` | JSON parameters file in the AWS CLI shape (`[{"ParameterKey":…,"ParameterValue":…}]`). Merged under `parameters`, which wins on conflict. |
| `capabilities` | no | `CAPABILITY_IAM` | Comma-separated capabilities. `CAPABILITY_IAM` / `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` are required when the template creates IAM resources; `CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND` for macros/SAM. |
| `tags` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `Key=Value` tags applied to every resource in the stack. |
| `change-set-name` | no | `""` | Change set name. Empty generates one from the run id. |
| `role-arn` | no | `""` | Service role CloudFormation assumes to act on resources. Lets the deploy role be narrow while CloudFormation itself holds the broad permissions. |
| `package` | no | `false` | 'true to run `aws cloudformation package` first, uploading local artifacts referenced by the template to S3. Required for SAM and for templates over 51,200 bytes.' |
| `s3-bucket` | no | `""` | Bucket for packaged artifacts. Required when `package` is true. |
| `s3-prefix` | no | `""` | Key prefix for packaged artifacts. |
| `termination-protection` | no | `false` | true to enable termination protection on the stack after a successful deploy. |
| `fail-on-empty-changeset` | no | `false` | 'false (default) treats "no changes" as success. Set true if an unchanged stack should fail — occasionally wanted in a promotion pipeline.' |
| `fail-on-replacement` | no | `false` | 'true to fail when the change set would REPLACE any resource. Worth enabling for stateful production stacks, where a replacement means data loss.' |
| `wait-timeout-minutes` | no | `60` | How long to wait for stack operations to reach a terminal state. |
| `max-comment-chars` | no | `50000` | Truncate the rendered diff to this many characters. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `stack-id` | The stack ID. |
| `change-set-id` | ARN of the change set that was created. |
| `change-set-name` | Name of the change set, for a later `mode: execute` run. |
| `has-changes` | `true` when the change set contains changes. |
| `replacements` | Count of resources the change set would replace. |
| `executed` | `true` when the change set was executed in this run. |
| `outputs-json` | The stack's outputs as a compact JSON object, after a successful execute. |
| `comment-body-file` | Markdown file describing the change set, for the `pr-comment` action. |
